import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

root = Path(Path('/tmp/tsr-late-bound-path').read_text().strip())
label = sys.argv[1]
assert not (root / (label + '.json')).exists(), label
command = sys.argv[2:]
source = root / 'source'

def hashes():
    return {str(p.relative_to(source)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            for p in sorted(source.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()
            and (p.suffix == '.rs' or p.name in ('Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock'))}

before = hashes()
env = os.environ.copy()
env['CARGO_TARGET_DIR'] = str(root / 'target')
env['CARGO_BUILD_JOBS'] = '2'
start = time.time()
with (root / (label + '.stdout')).open('w') as out, (root / (label + '.stderr')).open('w') as err:
    process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=source, env=env, stdout=out, stderr=err)
    print(json.dumps({'label': label, 'pid': process.pid, 'command': command}), flush=True)
    code = process.wait()
after = hashes()
record = {'label': label, 'pid': process.pid, 'command': command,
          'source_revision': json.loads((root / 'setup.json').read_text())['source'],
          'returncode': code, 'seconds': time.time() - start,
          'source_hashes_before': before, 'source_hashes_after': after,
          'source_unchanged_during_run': before == after,
          'stdout': (root / (label + '.stdout')).read_text(),
          'stderr': (root / (label + '.stderr')).read_text()}
record['stdout_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256((root / (label + '.stdout')).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
record['stderr_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256((root / (label + '.stderr')).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
record['stdout_bytes'] = (root / (label + '.stdout')).stat().st_size
record['stderr_bytes'] = (root / (label + '.stderr')).stat().st_size
if 'corpus' in label:
    record['stdout'] = record['stdout'][-2000:]
    record['stdout_retained_locally'] = str(root / (label + '.stdout'))
(root / (label + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
assert before == after, 'source mutated while work live'
print(json.dumps({k: record[k] for k in ('label', 'pid', 'returncode', 'seconds', 'source_unchanged_during_run')}))
print(record['stdout'][-5000:])
print(record['stderr'][-2000:])
sys.exit(code)

fixtures = {
    'computed': 'const key="x"; class C {[key]=1} declare const c:C; const ok:{x:number}=c; const wrong:{x:string}=c; const value:string=c[key];',
    'static': 'const key="x"; class C {static [key]=1; [key]="instance"} const ok:{x:number}=C; const wrong:{x:string}=C; const value:string=C[key]; declare const c:C; const instance:number=c[key];',

projects=[]
for name,text in fixtures.items():
    folder=r/'fixtures'/name
    folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    (folder/'input.ts').write_text(text+'\n')
    config=folder/'tsconfig.json'

    projects.append((name,config))
projects += [('domain',s/'benches/projects/domain-model-large/tsconfig.json'),('nextjs',Path('<private-nextjs>/tsconfig.json'))]
sources={p:perf.inputs.file_hash(s/p) for p in sorted(set(setup['baseline_hashes'])|set(json.loads((r/'probe-source.json').read_text())))}
sources.update({p:perf.inputs.file_hash(s/p) for p in ['scripts/whole_project_perf.py','scripts/benchmark_inputs.py']})
binary_hashes={name:perf.inputs.file_hash(r/name) for name in ['baseline-tsr','probe-tsr']}
state={'source':setup['source'],'source_hashes':sources,'binaries':binary_hashes,'runs':[],'listings':[],'complete':False,'actual_native_work_verified':False}
assert not (r/'controls.json').exists()

    assert {p:perf.inputs.file_hash(s/p) for p in sources}==sources
def parse_trace(base,pid,enabled):
    aggregate=base.read_text().splitlines()
    assert aggregate[0]=='schema\tmapper-pool-v1'
    process=aggregate[1].split('\t')
    assert process[0]=='process' and int(process[1])==pid and int(process[3])==int(enabled)
    count=int(process[2]); totals={}
    assert aggregate[-1].startswith('pool_joined\t')
    for row in aggregate[2:-1]:
        fields=row.split('\t')
        assert fields[0]=='count' and fields[1] not in totals
        totals[fields[1]]=int(fields[2])
    owners=[]
    for owner in range(count):
        lines=base.with_suffix(f'.owner-{owner}.tsv').read_text().splitlines()
        head=lines[0].split('\t')
        assert head[:4]==['owner',str(pid),str(owner),str(count)] and head[-1]=='1'
        local={}; checks=[]; capacities={}
        for row in lines[1:]:
            fields=row.split('\t')
            if fields[0]=='check':
                assert len(fields)==5
                checks.append({'index':int(fields[1]),'file':fields[4],'start':int(fields[2]),'end':int(fields[3])})
            elif fields[0]=='owner_count':
                assert fields[1] not in local
                local[fields[1]]=int(fields[2])
            elif fields[0]=='capacity':
                assert fields[1] not in capacities
                capacities[fields[1]]=int(fields[2])
            else: raise AssertionError(row)
        assert all(c['index']%count==owner for c in checks)
        owners.append({'owner':owner,'complete':True,'checks':checks,'counters':local,'capacities':capacities})
    if enabled:
        fields=['calls','elements','strings','string_len_bytes','string_capacity_bytes','vec_capacity_bytes','allocations','requested_bytes','usable_bytes','copy_ns']
        sites=['accessor_pair','method_overloads','static_names','static_lookup','instance_names','instance_lookup']
        kinds=['cached_read','active_read','publish_copy','consumer_name','static_projection']
        work=['workers','candidates','no_expression','no_name','publications','worker_inclusive_ns']
        required={f'late_bound_{site}_{kind}_{field}' for site in sites for kind in kinds for field in fields}
        required.update(f'late_bound_{site}_{field}' for site in sites for field in work)
        required.update('late_bound_copy_'+suffix for suffix in ['allocations','requested_bytes','usable_bytes'])
        assert len(totals)==436 and required.issubset(totals),'counter schema missing or changed'
        assert all(set(o['counters'])==set(totals) for o in owners),'owner schema differs'
        for name in required:
            assert totals[name]==sum(o['counters'][name] for o in owners),(name,'unowned traffic')
        for owner in owners:
            local=owner['counters']
            for suffix in ['allocations','requested_bytes','usable_bytes']:
